name: Earful
summary: A podcast episode card: drag the waveform to scrub, jump by chapter, change speed and roll on to Up next
about: A podcast episode card with cover art drawn in SVG and a waveform you can scrub. The played part of the waveform fills with colour, the bars dance while it plays and a glow follows the playhead. When the episode ends the bars cheer, little sound bars burst out and an Up next panel counts down before the next episode rises in.
how: Press play: the icon morphs to pause and the cover rings start to pulse.
Drag on the waveform (or use the arrow keys) to scrub; hover to see the time under the pointer.
Tap a chapter chip to glide to it, or skip back 15 and forward 30 seconds.
Tap the speed button to cycle 1x, 1.25x, 1.5x and 2x; Share moment copies a link at the current time.
Let the episode finish to see the cheer and the Up next countdown; Cancel keeps you on this episode.
